'''Armed conflicts and attacks''' 
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[2024 Israeli strikes on Yemen]]
***The death toll from yesterday's [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] airstrikes on [[Al Hudaydah]], [[Yemen]], increases to six. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/7/21/israels-war-on-gaza-live-dozens-killed-in-israeli-raids-on-gaza-yemen?update=3059829 (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] target [[Eilat]], [[Israel]], with multiple ballistic missiles, in response to yesterday's airstrikes in Yemen. [https://news.sky.com/story/houthis-target-israeli-city-of-eilat-in-wake-of-yemen-port-attack-13182600 (Sky News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] capture the villages of Andriivka in [[Luhansk Oblast]] and [[Pishchane, Kharkiv Oblast|Pishchane]] in [[Kharkiv Oblast]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/russia-ukraine-war/russia-says-it-took-control-of-2-settlements-in-ukraine-s-kharkiv-luhansk-regions/3281604 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/2215801.html (RTL)]
*[[2024 Bangladesh quota reform movement]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Bangladesh]] reduces the [[government of Bangladesh|government]] job quota reserved for families of veterans who fought in the [[Bangladesh Liberation War]] from 30% to 5%, leaving 93% of jobs to be allocated on merit and 2% set aside for [[Indigenous peoples in Bangladesh|ethnic minorities]], [[LGBT rights in Bangladesh|transgender]], and [[disability in Bangladesh|disabled people]]. [https://apnews.com/article/bangladesh-student-protests-curfew-government-jobs-quota-107847b2c1bdf4e52dfa0c82f51f3d4a (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Canadian wildfires]]
**[[Wildfire]]s continue to spread in northern [[Alberta]], [[Canada]], prompting [[emergency evacuation]]s in [[John D'Or Prairie 215]], [[Fox Lake, Alberta|Fox Lake]] and [[Garden River, Alberta|Garden River]]. At least 55 of the 158 active wildfires are reported as "out of control". [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/wildfires-canadas-alberta-british-columbia-prompt-evacuation-orders-2024-07-20/ (Reuters)]
*Six people, including two children, are killed in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] in [[West Yorkshire]], [[England]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/six-people-including-two-children-killed-in-car-crash-near-wakefield-13183064 (Sky News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Philippines relations]], [[Territorial disputes in the South China Sea]]
**The [[Philippines]] announces an agreement with [[China]] on resupply missions to the [[Beaching (nautical)|beached]] [[Philippine Navy|naval]] ship ''[[BRP Sierra Madre|Sierra Madre]]'' on [[Second Thomas Shoal]] in the [[South China Sea]] following [[June 2024 Second Thomas Shoal incident|an incident in June]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/article/2024/jul/22/china-and-philippines-deal-south-china-sea-sierra-madre (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Iran–Sudan relations]]
**[[Iran]] and [[Sudan]] receive each other's [[ambassador]]s for the first time in eight years, after resuming diplomatic relations in October 2023. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/21/iran-sudan-exchange-ambassadors-after-eight-years (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Conscription of yeshiva students]]
**[[Israel]] begins issuing call-up notices for [[Conscription in Israel|military conscription]] to [[Haredi Jews]] amid mass protests in [[Jerusalem]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-military-sends-draft-notices-ultra-orthodox-2024-07-21/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States presidential election]]
**[[Withdrawal of Joe Biden from the 2024 United States presidential election]] 
***[[Kamala Harris 2024 presidential campaign]]
****Incumbent [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that he will not seek a second term in office and ends his [[Joe Biden 2024 presidential campaign|presidential campaign]], while endorsing [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]] [[Kamala Harris]] as the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nominee. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2024-election/president-joe-biden-drops-2024-presidential-race-rcna159867 (NBC News)]
****Several prominent Democrats [[List of Kamala Harris 2024 presidential campaign endorsements|endorse]] Kamala Harris for president. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/07/21/us/politics/harris-democrats-campaign-nominee-biden.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[2024 anti-tourism protests in Spain]]
**Thousands of people protest in [[Palma de Mallorca]], [[Spain]], against [[mass tourism]] and [[private jet]]s in the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/thousands-protest-spains-mallorca-against-mass-tourism-2024-07-21/ (Reuters)]
*[[President of Tanzania|Tanzanian president]] [[Samia Suluhu Hassan]] dismisses [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Tanzania)|foreign minister]] [[January Makamba]] and [[Ministry of Information, Culture, Arts and Sports (Tanzania)|information minister]] [[Nape Nnauye]], replacing the latter with current [[Ministry of Lands, Housing and Human Settlements Developments|housing minister]] [[Jerry Silaa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tanzanias-president-dismisses-foreign-information-ministers-2024-07-22/ (Reuters)]
